title: CORE-7120 · /cookies-policy/ headings darker than live (#363636 vs #595959)
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7120](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7120/rf-cookies-policy-headings-darker-than-live-363636-vs-595959) · state `In Progress` · priority P3

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Page:** `/cookies-policy/`
**Live:** [https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/cookies-policy/](<https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/cookies-policy/>) · **Test:** [https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/cookies-policy](<https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/cookies-policy>)
**Component/area:** body rich-text section headings — every `<h2>` / `<h3>` on this page has its whole text wrapped in bold in the CMS content
**Breakpoints:** 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800 — all four

**Issue** — all eight section headings on this page render darker on the clone than on live. On live the bold wrapper carries `#595959` and that overrides the heading colour, so the headings render `#595959`. On the clone the bold wrapper has no colour, so the heading colour `#363636` shows through.

### What's wrong

|  | Expected (Live) | Actual (Clone) |
| -- | -- | -- |
| rendered heading `color` | `#595959` (`rgb(89, 89, 89)`) | `#363636` (`rgb(54, 54, 54)`) |
| `<h2>` / `<h3>` element `color` | `#363636` (`rgb(54, 54, 54)`) | `#363636` (`rgb(54, 54, 54)`) |
| `font-size` — h2 / h3 | 26px / 22px | 26px / 22px |
| `font-weight` on the bold wrapper | 700 | 700 |

Sizes and weight match — colour is the only difference, and it is the same at all four breakpoints. Confirmed two ways: computed `color`, and the painted glyph pixels (`rgb(89, 89, 89)` on live, `rgb(54, 54, 54)` on the clone, with the same glyph pixel count on both, so the text and size are identical).

**All eight headings affected:**

| Heading | Level |
| -- | -- |
| Definition of "cookie" | h2 |
| Do I have to agree to the use of cookies? | h2 |
| Which cookies are used on our website? | h2 |
| A. Essential Cookies | h3 |
| B. Functionality Cookies | h3 |
| C. Analytical/Performance Cookies | h3 |
| D. Targeting Cookies | h3 |
| I have further questions, who can I contact? | h2 |

### Steps to navigate

1. Go to `/cookies-policy/` at 1800px on both sites.
2. Compare the **Definition of "cookie"** heading with the paragraph underneath it.
3. **Live:** heading and body text are the same grey. · **Clone:** the heading is darker than the body text.

### Definition of Done

- [ ] All eight headings render `#595959`, matching live, at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800.
- [ ] The bold wrapper's colour overrides the heading colour, as it does on live — the `<h2>` / `<h3>` colour itself does not need to change.
- [ ] Heading size, weight and line wrapping are unchanged, and the spacing above and below each heading does not move.
- [ ] Body copy, lists and the cookie tables underneath are untouched — they already match live at `#595959`.

### Evidence

The **Definition of "cookie"** heading with the paragraph below it, both sites headless at `deviceScaleFactor: 1`.

**1800px**

| Live | Clone |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

**360px**

| Live | Clone |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

The tell is the heading against the line beneath it: level on live, heading darker than the body text on the clone. The colour values above are the reliable check — 26px against `#595959` vs `#363636` is a small step on screen.

---
### Planning note
Serialized behind CORE-7119: both change body rich-text bold colour handling and they are semantically coupled — 7119 must darken body bold to #313131 WITHOUT darkening heading bold, which is exactly what this task asserts. Same selector family = file conflict, so never concurrent.

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
